thread.title: Stocks - Biogen Soars in Pre-market, Intel, Ford, Netflix, Facebook Drop

title: Stocks - Biogen Soars in Pre-market, Intel, Ford, Netflix, Facebook Drop
text: Stocks in focus in pre-market trade on Friday More Investing.com - Stocks in focus in pre-market trade Friday: • Biogen (BIIB) stock soared 12.8% by 7:58AM ET (11:58GMT) after announcing positive topline results from a Phase 2 clinical study of its drug for patients with early Alzheimer’s disease. • Intel (INTC) stock lost 0.2% on tech media reports that Apple (AAPL) will not use the firm’s 5G modem chips for iPhones planned for 2020. • Ford (F) stock dropped 0.2% as the firm announced that China vehicle sales slumped 38% in June from a year earlier to 62,057 vehicles. • Netflix (NFLX) stock fell 0.5% despite the fact that the company announced a testing of a premium plan in Europe that would offer higher image quality along with the ability to watch on four screens at the same time. • Facebook (FB) stock traded down 0.5% amid a Variety report that the company was in talks to launch a Cristiano Ronaldo reality show. According to the report, the famous soccer player would receive $10 million for a 13 episode run. • PriceSmart (PSMT) tumbled 7.4% as fiscal third quarter earnings per share missed consensus.
